Actor.policy: Display name is not identity. An alias maps to an Actor only with evidence; geography and narrative roles remain separate.

Indicator.policy: Variable definition, population, unit and measurement basis determine identity; observations do not define the variable.

Mechanism.policy: Reusable causal structure and applicability determine identity; usage analyst does not become mechanism author.

Source.policy: Carrier identity is separate from content truth. Same URL does not guarantee the same SourceVersion.

SourceFamily.policy: Shared article text can indicate shared origin; establish proposition/segment origin with evidence before grouping.

ASSERTED_BY.name: ASSERTED_BY
ASSERTED_BY.semantic_description: Claim claimant attribution; identity evidence remains required.

CONTRADICTS.name: CONTRADICTS
CONTRADICTS.semantic_description: Recorded claim disagreement; not the Core structural Contradiction type.

DERIVED_FROM.name: DERIVED_FROM
DERIVED_FROM.semantic_description: Recorded derivation with reasoner attribution; no causal validity assertion.

PART_OF.name: PART_OF
PART_OF.semantic_description: Source segment membership in carrier or captured version.

REFERS_TO.name: REFERS_TO
REFERS_TO.semantic_description: Explicit evaluation or review target; no target mutation.

SUPPORTED_BY.name: SUPPORTED_BY
SUPPORTED_BY.semantic_description: Recorded support reference, not truth propagation or sufficient evidence.

USES_MECHANISM.name: USES_MECHANISM
USES_MECHANISM.semantic_description: Usage does not establish mechanism authorship.

VERSION_OF.name: VERSION_OF
VERSION_OF.semantic_description: Versioned carrier reference, distinct from URL identity.
